title: German Flatbread with Peruvian Salsa
description: A twist on traditional German flatbread, topped with a vibrant peruvian salsa and a dollop of sour cream.
instructions: 2. Roll out the flatbread to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
3. Bake the flatbread for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
4. Meanwhile, mix together the peruvian salsa ingredients.
5. Spread the salsa over the flatbread, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
6. Dollop the sour cream over the salsa.
7. Sprinkle the cilantro over the top.
8. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
9. Slice the flatbread into wedges and serve immediately.
